final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.death_country AS c FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id), g AS (SELECT c, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY c), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.c, g.cnt, 1.0 * g.cnt / t.total AS share FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s) SELECT s.c AS death_country, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avgshare AS share_minus_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avgshare ORDER BY s.share DESC
